entries.title: Psalms 32:1
segments: A Psalm of David. A Contemplation. Blessed [is] the man whose transgression [is] forgiven, whose sin [is] covered.

entries.title: Psalms 32:2
segments: Blessed [is] the man to whom the LORD does not charge iniquity, and in whose spirit there [is] no guile.

entries.title: Psalms 32:3
segments: When I kept silence, my bones became old through my roaring all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 32:4
segments: For by day and by night Your hand [was] heavy on me; my sap is turned into the droughts of summer. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 32:5
segments: I confessed my sin to You, and my iniquity I have not hidden. I said, I will confess my transgression to the LORD; and You forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 32:6
segments: For this let every godly one pray to You, in a time when You may be found; surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come near him.

entries.title: Psalms 32:7
segments: You [are] my hiding place; You shall preserve me from trouble; You shall circle [me] with songs of deliverance. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 32:8
segments: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you should go; I will counsel you, My eye [shall be] on you.

entries.title: Psalms 32:9
segments: Be not like the horse, [or] like the mule, who have no understanding, whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, so [that] they do not come near you.

entries.title: Psalms 32:10
segments: The wicked [has] many sorrows, but mercy embraces him who trusts in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 32:11
segments: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous; and shout for joy, all [you] upright in heart.
